anita: Heads-up — after quantizing qwen-7b-v2 to int8 we see a consistent drop on our rerank MRR test (~6-8%). Baseline float32 run is fine. Suspect an embedding layout/stride mismatch during our loader conversion.
chris: oof. which loader? the unified loader or the qwen-special-case path?
anita: unified loader. conversion script does `weights.reshape((out, in))` assuming row-major; qwen checkpoint might be saved column-major for embedding layers. I can share a tiny snippet.
anita: ```python
# suspect conversion
w = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.float32)
w = w.reshape((n_out, n_in))  # might need order='F'
save_quantized(w)
```
mike: that would flip the inner products. Have you tried loading with `order='F'` and running a quick dot-check vs float baseline?
chris: also confirm embedding dim ordering vs token embedding vs transformer first linear. If dims are swapped by a stride, quantization amplifies the error.
tara: can you run the eval bot on both variants (row-major vs col-major) and post metrics? if it's consistent we can add a conversion flag and a regression test.
anita: kicked off two jobs: `qwen7b-int8-row` and `qwen7b-int8-col`. eval-bot should post results when done.
eval-bot: job qwen7b-int8-row finished. eval set: rerank-small. MRR=0.716 (baseline float32=0.771). latency 28ms/token.
eval-bot: job qwen7b-int8-col finished. eval set: rerank-small. MRR=0.766 (baseline float32=0.771). latency 29ms/token.
chris: wow col-major nearly recovers. That's pretty convincing.
mike: nice. so conversion script needs `order='F'` for qwen embeddings (or a generic detection). Could add heuristic: compute cosine between quantized and float embedding mean vectors to detect flip.
tara: agree. also add unit test in `model-converters` that loads a tiny random checkpoint saved in both orders and asserts parity after conversion.
anita: i'll patch loader: try to detect by checking `abs(dot(row1_row2))` vs `abs(dot(col1_col2))` but simple check first: try both and pick the one with higher eval MRR on a tiny synthetic set.
chris: keep it lightweight — prefer deterministic heuristics over running evals in conversion path. maybe check file header or shape metadata first.
mike: if no metadata, detection via checking first 512 tokens dot products against float baseline is ok for offline conversion.
tara: follow-up: please open a tiny PR with conversion change + regression test + a short comment in onboarding docs that qwen checkpoints may use column-major embeddings. mark as semver-minor.
anita: will do. creating PR now, assigning to @chris and @mike for review. thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:
chris: yay. also add a note for Dedicated custom deploys — we should ensure quantized images include conversion sanity checks in CI.
mike: filed a ticket in board: INF-1429 "quant conversion: detect embedding stride/order for qwen/others".
anita: great. I'll add the test vector and close the loop once PR merges.
